title: DGG / Goemans cost conjecture for single-source unsplittable flow: counterexample

original_sources.citation: Vera Traub, Laura Vargas Koch and Rico Zenklusen, Single-Source Unsplittable Flows in Planar Graphs, arXiv:2308.02651v1 (2023-08-04), Definition 1.1, preceding flow-conservation equations and Conjecture 1.3 (Goemans).

scope: Refute the rational existence form of Goemans cost conjecture (Conjecture 1.3 of arXiv:2308.02651v1) by showing that even finite simple loopless acyclic instances with distinct non-source terminals, positive demands with an attained maximum, nonnegative costs and feasible fractional flow respecting capacities need not admit a routing satisfying both the additive-dmax arc-load bound and the fractional-cost bound. The registered predicate permits finite walks; correspondence to the original path formulation and the restricted-instance refutation direction remain pending mathematical review. No planarity, real-number, two-sided-bound, priority or award claim is registered.
